core_business: OP Stack (Optimism) fork of go-ethereum serving as the execution layer for XLayer L2 chain (mainnet chainID 196, testnet chainID 1952). Handles EVM execution, block building/import via Engine API from op-node consensus client, transaction pool with rollup L1+operator fee calculation, state/trie management with LevelDB/Pebble/RocksDB backends, P2P sync, JSON-RPC API serving, and XLayer-specific migration routing to legacy Erigon node for pre-migration blocks.

core_modules.description: Blockchain core: canonical chain management, EVM execution, transaction pool, state database, raw storage, genesis initialization

sub_modules.function: Ethereum Virtual Machine: opcode interpreter, gas metering, precompiled contracts
Transaction pool: validation, subpool management (legacy, blob), rollup cost, ingress filters
State database: account/storage state access, snapshot layer, journal
Raw database operations: block/receipt/header storage, ancient freezer, chain metadata
Core data types: Block, Header, Transaction, Receipt with OP Stack extensions

core_modules.description: Ethereum service: full node backend, P2P handler, Engine API catalyst, downloader, filters, tracers

sub_modules.function: Engine API: CL-EL bridge for block building and import via ForkchoiceUpdated/NewPayload/GetPayload
Block/state synchronization: full sync, snap sync, beacon sync
EVM execution tracing: call tracer, prestate tracer, flatcall tracer

core_modules.description: Consensus engine interface and implementations: beacon (PoS), clique (PoA), ethash (PoW legacy)

sub_modules.function: Beacon consensus engine for post-merge PoS

core_modules.description: Block building: payload assembly, transaction ordering, OP Stack sequencer support
Node lifecycle: service container, RPC server hosting (HTTP/WS/IPC/Auth), database opener
P2P networking: peer connections, discovery v4/v5, RLPx transport, XLayer ETH69 compatibility
JSON-RPC 2.0 framework: service registry, reflection-based dispatch, subscription support
Trie database: path-based and hash-based backends for state trie node storage

sub_modules.function: Path-based state scheme with diff layers and state history

core_modules.description: Database abstraction layer: KV store and ancient/freezer interfaces
Chain parameters, fork configurations, OP Stack and XLayer overrides
Shared types (Hash, Address), utilities, LRU caches, hex encoding, monotonic clock
Public Ethereum JSON-RPC API implementation via Backend interface
OP Stack superchain network configuration loading from embedded TOML
Main geth binary: CLI entry point, flag definitions, configuration loading

summary: Backend Go 1.24 OP Stack fork of go-ethereum for XLayer L2 (chainID 196/1952): EVM, Engine API, txpool with rollup fees, Pebble/LevelDB storage, P2P sync, JSON-RPC API
